timing_interpretation: Patient age at initial radical prostatectomy diagnosis
Pathologic T stage determined by surgical pathologist at resection
Lymph node staging determined at surgical lymphadenectomy
Primary and secondary Gleason score on resected prostate specimen
High-throughput RNA sequencing of resected primary tumor tissue
Follow-up surveillance PSA (median 511 days post-op, 271 of 276 values >0 days post-surgery)
immortal_time_risk: High if treated as pre-operative baseline; evaluated separately in sensitivity analysis
